Package au.csiro.pathling.ecl.generated

Class EclBaseListener

java.lang.Object
au.csiro.pathling.ecl.generated.EclBaseListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
EclListener, org.antlr.v4.runtime.tree.ParseTreeListener
public class EclBaseListener extends Object implements EclListener
This class provides an empty implementation of EclListener, which can be extended to create a listener which only needs to handle a subset of the available methods.
